dct_description_sm: Simulation output for the reference simulation (EXP-0) and for the 121 sensitivity simulations discussed in Benoît-Gagné et al.: Interannual controls of the phytoplankton assemblages in Baffin Bay (in prep). The model simulations were configured in one dimension to represent the location of the ice camp of the Green Edge mission in western Baffin Bay at 67.48 N, 63.79 W in 2016. See 0-README for more metadata.
dct_title_s: Modelled phytoplankton in Baffin Bay for a study on the assemblages
